title: Wildcard accepted domain is not configured
description: Exchange MUST NOT use an exact wildcard (*) accepted domain without a documented and approved design. A wildcard accepted domain can permit relay behavior beyond intended recipient domains. An InternalRelay wildcard is also associated with Exchange Transport service crashes.
subject: Organization

references.name: CSS HealthChecker Open Relay Domain guidance
Allow anonymous relay on Exchange servers

remediation.description: Review the accepted domain, its type, receive connector permissions, and required mail-flow design. Remove or replace an exact wildcard only after confirming the change will not disrupt valid relay or recipient delivery.

considerations: The check matches only an exact accepted domain of *. It does not flag wildcard subdomains such as *.contoso.com. HealthChecker notes that an InternalRelay accepted domain of * is not recommended and can cause Transport service crashes. Validate connector scope and mail flow before making changes.
